title: eludite.navigation.go_to_all output
description: The results of the current query, best first. File results come at once from the index; symbol results stream in from each language server, so `state` is `loading` while a server has not answered (an agent's call waits up to 5 s for all of them).

query.description: The query the results are for.

filter.description: The filter in effect (from the prefix or `filter`).

state.description: `loading`: a language server has not answered yet; `done`: every source answered; `navigated`: `select` opened a result.

name.description: The file name or the symbol's name.

kind.description: `file`, or the symbol's kind in Visual Studio's words: `class`, `struct`, `interface`, `enum`, `delegate`, `method`, `property`, `field`, `event`, `constructor`, `enum_member`, `constant`, `namespace`, `variable`, `function`, `module`, `type_parameter`, `operator`, `symbol`, or `line`.

container.description: Where it is: the containing type or namespace for a symbol, the folder relative to the workspace for a file.

path.description: Absolute path of the file that holds it.

line.description: 1-based line, for a symbol or a line.

column.description: 1-based column, for a symbol or a line.

score.description: The fuzzy match score (higher ranks first).

server.description: The language server that reported a symbol (its status bar name).

servers_pending.description: Language servers that have not answered the query yet.

message.description: A server's failure, or why `select` did nothing.
